about: R1 search and R2 iterator-workspace mutants, owned by nfa. WorkspaceReusesStorage catches per-line storage setup invisible to Boolean agreement; WorkspaceAgreesWithReferences catches stale frontier/marks, frontier overwrite, lost epsilon branches and wrong acceptance mode. Matcher.LinesAgree and LinesStop cover iterator ordering and consumer stop.

mutants.name: R2-whole-iterator-value
mutants.rule: Matcher.LinesAgree checks emitted Whole line values, not only counts. The existing Whole CLI case uses count mode, the workspace property checks Whole booleans and Inside line values, and Matches laws cannot observe iterator payloads.

mutants.name: R2-shared-iterator
mutants.rule: Scratch belongs inside the iterator invocation. The existing S108 mutable-capture rule rejects this mutant before execution; no new test duplicates that checker guard.

mutants.name: R2-stale-frontier
mutants.rule: A line starts with no frontier from the preceding line; WorkspaceAgreesWithReferences reuses storage across generated texts.

mutants.name: R2-stale-marks
mutants.rule: Reset advances the closure generation, even after an early accept.

mutants.name: R2-frontier-alias
mutants.rule: A transition writes the other frontier, not the active frontier being read.

mutants.name: R2-split-arm
mutants.rule: Epsilon closure reaches both Split arms; the original Simulation and tree model reach both.

mutants.name: R2-early-accept
mutants.rule: Inside may accept before End.

mutants.name: R2-whole
mutants.rule: Whole accepts only at End, not when a prefix accepts.

mutants.name: R2-reallocate
mutants.rule: WorkspaceReusesStorage rejects repeating storage initialization per line even when outputs agree.

mutants.name: R2-yield-stop
mutants.rule: LinesStop rejects pulling another source line after yield returns false.

mutants.name: R2-rollover
mutants.rule: Generation rollover must clear old marks before generation one is reused.

mutants.rule: Complete literals need no NFA starts or transitions.

mutants.name: R1-alt-prefix
mutants.rule: Only the common prefix of both alternatives is required.

mutants.name: R1-nullable-prefix
mutants.from:
case Any, Class, Star, Quest:
		Prefix{Text: "", Complete: false}
mutants.rule: An optional head may match empty, so its operand is not required.

mutants.name: R1-overlap
mutants.rule: After a candidate, another prefix may start inside it.

mutants.name: R1-whole
mutants.rule: Whole mode must stay anchored, including complete literals.

mutants.name: R1-early-accept
mutants.rule: Inside accepts before End; trailing bytes cannot undo a match.

mutants.name: R1-no-prefix-fallback
mutants.rule: No required prefix is not evidence of no match; nullable patterns still match.

mutants.name: R1-live-candidate
mutants.rule: Starting a later candidate must preserve earlier live configurations.

mutants.name: R1-cat-incomplete
mutants.rule: A concatenation cannot require bytes after an unknown or variable-length head.

mutants.name: R1-plus-complete
mutants.rule: One required literal occurrence does not make a repeat a complete literal.

mutants.name: R1-rescan
mutants.rule: SearchTransitionsAreLinear rejects redundant suffix rescans that Boolean agreement cannot see; the actual sequential-candidate implementation at bb95113d is also red under this law.
